name: Your Company
tagline: Fine wrought iron with gilding, patina and bronze

listing.description: A website for a fine ironwork atelier: dark velvet with a golden sheen, collections in a showcase, the workshop and showroom bookings.

seo.title: Your Company — gilded fine ironwork in Tashkent
seo.description: Staircase balustrades, gates, fire screens and furniture in wrought iron with gold leaf, patina and bronze detail. Bespoke design, handmade, 10-year guarantee.
seo.answer: Your Company is a fine ironwork atelier in Tashkent: balustrades, gates, fire screens and furniture with gold leaf, patina and bronze. Staircase balustrade from 6,800,000 UZS per linear metre, fire screens from 14,000,000 UZS. Design in 7 days, made in 6–10 weeks, 10-year guarantee. Showroom in Mirabad, phone +998 71 200-07-06.

sections.title: Ironwork touched by gold
sections.subtitle: Balustrades, gates, fire screens and furniture forged by hand and finished in gold leaf. Each piece exists only once — to your design or ours.

sections.label: The atelier
sections.title: Metal made to be handed down
sections.text: The atelier has three smiths, a chaser and a gilder who lays 23.75-carat gold leaf by hand onto an oil size. We never use “gold” paint: the gold on our pieces is real and does not darken with time.
